title: Back the next chapter.
label: The M3MM story
points: What we build
M3MM brings together client websites, practical software, and reusable delivery tools. This presentation walks through the work, the infrastructure behind it, and a focused funding request.
How to explore

You can pause me at any time, choose a chapter, or click a step to jump. Recorded software demos show actual workflows, with more detail available beside each step. Other entries have labeled overviews. Each project keeps its current status.
The ask

We are discussing a long-term, phased investment in reliable infrastructure, secure development and local artificial intelligence. No funding commitment or investor terms have been agreed. Let’s start with the portfolio.

title: The foundation already exists.
label: Development infrastructure
points: Current capacity

The October ninth inventory records the existing server with a two-core Pentium processor, about sixteen gigabytes of memory, and an RTX thirty fifty graphics card with six gigabytes of video memory. Those resources support local models, application hosting, and background work.
Supporting equipment

A Windows workstation handles delivery and creative work. A ThinkPad provides portable Linux development. Two Raspberry Pi three boards support monitoring and network tooling. The historical Linux desktop shares the server chassis, so it is not counted as a separate server.
What is verified

The ThinkPad connection was verified on October tenth. The server and both Pis were offline during that check, so their hardware details remain dated. Hardware upgrades must be paired with power checks, backups, and a successful restore.

title: A serious long-term build.
label: Proposed funding strategy
points: Start with reliability
The first stage protects existing work: independent backups, successful sample restores, reliable power and a separate firewall for the lab while household internet remains unchanged.
Build reusable capacity
Later stages add central storage and virtualization, then an expandable local AI workstation with high GPU memory when benchmarks and business needs justify the investment.
Discuss terms before capital

A hypothetical contribution schedule is two hundred fifty dollars from the founder plus two hundred fifty dollars from outside contributors collectively every two weeks. One hundred twenty American-minted one-troy-ounce silver coins are also under discussion. None of this is pledged, received or valued here; ownership and legal terms must be agreed first.

title: Measure what the funding changes.
label: Acceptance milestones
points: Measure first

Before buying, record the time and resource use of a representative local-model task, product build, and background job. Compare reuse, upgraded hardware, and rented compute before choosing the final quote.
Prove recovery
After installation, verify hardware operation, thermals, protected power, and an isolated backup restore. Move critical workloads only after the acceptance checks pass.
Show the difference

Repeat the same workloads and present before-and-after evidence. Pair the results with recorded product demonstrations. The proposal is for measured capacity and reliability, not an invented performance multiplier.
